claims: The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) is closed on Friday, April 3, 2026, in observance of Good Friday.
U.S. stock market regular trading hours are 9:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. ET.
U.S. stock market regular trading hours will resume on Monday, April 6, 2026.
The bond market will close early at noon ET on Friday, April 3, 2026.
The U.S. stock market is closed on Friday, April 3, 2026 (Good Friday).
The U.S. stock market's next closure is Monday, May 25, 2026 (Memorial Day).
